title: Your First CNC Relief Carving, Start to Finish: File, Board, Setup, Cut, Finish, Hang
excerpt: The complete walk-through for a first relief carving on a hobby router: choosing a file that will forgive you, the board, the CAM setup in plain steps, clamping and zeroing, the roughing and finishing passes, the finish, and hanging it. One weekend, one board, with links to the deeper guide at every step.
seo_title: How to Carve Your First CNC Relief: Complete Step-by-Step Guide
seo_description: A complete first CNC relief carving walkthrough: pick a forgiving STL, choose the board, set up the CAM (Aspire, VCarve, Carveco, Fusion), clamp and zero, rough and finish, sand, seal, glaze and oil, and hang it. Every step with the numbers.

email.subject: Your first relief carving, start to finish, in one weekend
email.intro:
Everything we have published so far goes deep on one thing: bits, wood, finishing, scaling, judging a file. This one goes wide instead. It is the whole first carving in order, from the file you download to the hanger on the back, with the deeper guide linked at every step.

If you own a router and have not yet carved a relief, start here. If you have carved one and it disappointed you, start here too; the order is usually what went wrong.
